content.text: {"decision":"explain","likely_cause":"Likely cause: after Save is clicked on purchase order:new, a coverage overlay is shown and stays up until about 15 s later, so the screen does not respond during that wait.","fix":"Fix: On the purchase order:new screen, remove the blocking overlay from the Save button's handler as soon as the save request is sent and show a progress state on the Save button itself, so the screen stays responsive for the roughly 15 s save.","cited_event_ids":["418","420:w450","423","424:x458"],"confidence":"med","unsupported":["The server-side cause of the 15 s save latency is not in the events","The events do not show what the overlay element is or whether it blocks input","The event windows do not show the save response itself"]}
